name: Teqnion AB (publ)
summary: Teqnion AB (publ), a diversified industrial company, provides a range of products in selected niche markets in Sweden, United Kingdom, European Union, Norway, United States, and internationally. It markets and sells instruments and consumables for clinical and research laboratories. It also offers foldable electric wheelchairs for county councils and end users; surge protection/lightning protection, uninterruptible power supply, and equalization material products; fasteners, hydraulic components, pipe parts, gaskets, seals, ball bearings, lifting products, and transmission items; and lamps and home furnishing products.
